2921-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.

5686-7084-7889.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4067-7132-7824.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Your deck size is 8 or greater.
4067-7132-7824.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw eight cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 until you have at least {5}{U} in your mana pool.
Repeat from step 1.

2173-2292-5220-7452.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2060-3497-4222-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Ezzaroot Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Ezzaroot Channeler.
2060-3497-4222-6996.description:
Activate Ezzaroot Channeler by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

527-2079-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.n: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

11-6070-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
You control at least two Doctors.
11-6070-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting and returning the original Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

323-2173-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1247-2347-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Firemind Vessel's ability by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2018-2412-4053.description:
Activate Crosis's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {U}{B}{R}.
When Crosis's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Crosis's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

56-2523-4976-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-2523-4976-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Open the Graves and Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-2523-4976-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

2034-2486--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2034-2486--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Repeat.

345-2034-5189.notablePrerequisites:
A creature you control has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Saproling" chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-2034-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ghave ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saproling tokens and/or sacrifice the Saprolings to Ghave's second ability.

413-1856-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
413-1856-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, pairing it and the Zombie.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

643-2783-3510.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
643-2783-3510.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Maskwood Nexus, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Repeat step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates an infinite mandatory loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.

224-578-2043-2119.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
224-578-2043-2119.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Seat of the Synod that is a 1/1 Soldier.
When the Seat of the Synod token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.
If you have four or more artifact cards in hand, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

719-2122-3334-4997.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Merfolk" or "Knight" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2122-3334-4997.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2091-4499.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four tapped lands.
147-2091-4499.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting an opponent with at least four cards in their hand.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Mana Geyser.
Resolve the copy of Mana Geyser, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

717-1445-4050.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Bone Miser triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {B}.
Repeat.
